title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to SpongeBob?
description:
A 1938 pact, two prime ministers, a queen and a London soccer clinic connect Adolf Hitler to SpongeBob SquarePants.

Adolf Hitler → Neville Chamberlain → Winston Churchill → Elizabeth II → Michelle Obama → SpongeBob SquarePants

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Neville Chamberlain: In 1938, Hitler signed the Munich deal with Britain's Neville Chamberlain.
   Photo, CC BY-SA 3.0 de: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Munich_Agreement_Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-R69173.jpg
2. Neville Chamberlain → Winston Churchill: In 1940, Winston Churchill replaced Chamberlain as prime minister.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Churchill_and_Chamberlain.jpg
3. Winston Churchill → Queen Elizabeth II: In 1945, Churchill celebrated victory beside a young Princess Elizabeth.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Special_Film_Project_186_-_Buckingham_Palace_2.jpg
4. Queen Elizabeth II → Michelle Obama: In 2009, the Queen welcomed Michelle Obama to Buckingham Palace.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_Michelle_Obama_Queen_Elizabeth_II_Buckingham_Palace_London.jpg
5. Michelle Obama → SpongeBob: And in 2012, Michelle Obama played soccer in London with SpongeBob.
   Photo by Tim Whitby/Getty Images for Nickelodeon, Fair use (commentary): https://www.cbsnews.com/pictures/michelle-obama-at-the-olympics

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #spongebobsquarepants #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
